name: SMRT
recent: SMRT Holdings 已于2026年10月20日从 ACE Market 转至 Bursa Malaysia Main Market 上市，并获豁免土著股权规定。公司将于2026年12月4日召开第二十二届常年股东大会，同时更新关联方交易股东授权。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比下滑7.4%，净利同比减少36.2%。
notable: 公司于2026年10月20日从 ACE Market 转板至 Bursa Malaysia Main Market 上市。
公司获得豁免遵守 Main Market 转板的土著股权规定。
公司将于2026年12月4日召开第二十二届常年股东大会。
risks: 董事在闭市期前表示有意进行证券交易。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为12,531,000令吉，同比下滑7.4%，环比增长2.8%；净利为4,090,000令吉，同比减少36.2%，环比微增0.6%；净利率为32.6%，低于去年同期的33.3%。

recent_en: SMRT Holdings transferred its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia on 20 October 2026 and was exempted from the Bumiputera equity requirement. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 7.4% year-on-year and net profit declined 36.2% year-on-year.
notable_en: The company transferred its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia on 20 October 2026.
The company was exempted from the Bumiputera equity requirement for its Main Market transfer.
risks_en: Directors have given notice of intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR12,531,000, down 7.4% year-on-year but up 2.8% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR4,090,000, down 36.2% year-on-year but up 0.6% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 32.6%, lower than 33.3% a year earlier.
